messages:
hannah: opened PR to add a compact migration guide for the new quota/rate headers + tiny SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6012

liam: Can we keep examples tiny (curl, python-sdk, node) and include a one-line PromQL so infra can verify dashboards?

hannah: Added examples: curl `curl -H 'x-redwood-quota: gold' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`, python `from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=...)
client.request('/v1/generate', headers={'x-redwood-quota':'gold'})`, node `fetch(url,{headers:{'x-redwood-quota':'gold'}})`; PromQL: `sum by(tier_label)(increase(billing.tier_assigned[7d]))` with short explanation.

priya: Small nit: recommend lowercase headers (proxies can downcase). Also add a deprecation banner for legacy headers and a 3-step checklist at the top.

enzo: Eng note: Dedicated accounts apply reserve before burst; suggest wording change from "unlimited burst" to "burst after reserve" and tag eng-runtime to confirm dedicated metric names.

hannah: Tagging eng-runtime. Added checklist (1 pin SDK >=0.9.2, 2 update headers, 3 smoke test staging) and yellow deprecation callout. docs-bot: can we get a preview?

docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-6012--docs.redwood.ai/quotas/migration (expires in 7 days).

liam: Quick smoke passed on staging, PromQL returned expected counts. Merging in 5m if no objections.

hannah: Thanks team 389 will follow up with a small PR to attach a dashboard thumbnail + Dedicated metric mapping once eng confirms.
